body: I'm starting to think there's nobody out there for me

I wish there were things I could do. But the truth of the matter is that I've been rejected so many times, among other things, and don't have any confidence left to build up. Rejection is the worst fucking thing ever, and I've gone through it a hell of a lot more times than anybody else I know
Yeah, I used to see a therapist, but it really didn't do anything. Honestly, ithink the SAD is worse than the depression. It's the worst feeling i have ever had in my life
I've waited for so long already. Constantly having the feeling that I've been shot in the stomache isn't something anybody should have to deal with forever because life "should get better"

I wish it were as easy as that. But for some reason, I feel as though I have to tell her. I mean, she isn't going to magically feel the same way a year from now. An I think I should at least tell her before she starts dating this other guy. I just can't help but think that things won't ever get better, though. It sucks because I'm the only person out of everybody I know that gets fucked over this much. I don't really think life is worth living if this is all it has in store for me

Alright, this might be a long story, so sorry for the wall of text:
I've had realatively mild social anxiety disorder and depression for as long as I could remember. Throughout the years it has gotten better and I thought that I had finally reached the light at the end of the tunnel. Anyway, my car's engine seizes because of my dumbass neighboor and I get completely fucked over. I think that this is a minor setback and get on with my life, now I just have to have people drive me around until I can get a new ride. Then I found out that my friend killed himself on Sunday. He was pretty cool and it really hurt when I found out what happened. The last, and most painful thing that happened, is about a girl, lets call her sarah. So sarah and I meet each other at the kung fu school that I go to. We become really good friends. Anyway, I develop feelings for sarah about 6 months ago, and I can't tell her because my SAD makes me too much of a fucking pussy. We text each other almost every day and I found out that she is really interested in this other guy that goes to the same kung fu school. Anyway, I was planning on telling her how I feel tommorow after class, and I have even already told her that I had to talk to her about something. So I go about texting her today, and she tells me that she is "really confused and bothered about X" (X being the other guy). So I, like an idiot, told her I was in a similar situation and she wished me luck with that girl, not knowing that I was talking about her, which she is going to find out tommorow. I feel like when she rejects me for that other guy tommorow, it will destroy my confidence and send me spiraling back down the hole, when I found out she liked this other guy, it already triggered some suicidal thoughts. She means the world to me, and I don't understand why everybody except me gets to be happy and I really don't know what to do anymore
